whole_book_review: Sequential chapter review completed for saved draft and recorded claims. Final cross-book continuity, dated-litigation refresh and completion audit remain required; no independent proof/priority certification.

historical_scale_revision.scope: Earlier targeted historical-scale revision, subsequently included in the complete sequential chapter review recorded in sequential_review.
historical_scale_revision.boundary: No inevitable historical decline, finite-budget diagnosis of any actual market, independent proof/priority certification, or automatic policy/liability inference.

sequential_review.method: Complete body and notes read in order after Chapter 4; changed passages re-read in local context; targeted primary checks address new procedural details, measured outcomes, precise judgment terms and dated case index.
findings: Search quality and unlawful exclusion remain attributed dated findings in the separate general-search case.
Query behavior explains useful scale; modeled allocation chance not query count, bytes, observed shares or independent-trial count.
Project Folly replaces another generic Aster trial and remains evidence of actual internal learning with a bounded target.
Judgment index fields and retained third-party IP rights show what a concrete knowledge-access obligation supplies.
40% first-year syndication cap and intended five-year tapering distinguish access from eventual independent capability; later court determinations not invented.
Mozilla choice-screen section now supplies actual same-design timing contrast, names preset alternatives accurately, and separates causal intervention from proposed psychological mechanism.
Meghani prior terminology, dicamba historical testing record, Herod narrative and pharmaceutical empirical study retain distinct scopes.
Default switches are observed interventions, not randomized replays; private tests count and existing-data access differs from prospective testing.
2026 implementation/appeal records remain dated party evidence, with no claim of completed delivery, current universal terms, final remedy success or appellate resolution.
